prose:
Verdict: defective.

The submitted employment reference letter was evaluated against Express Entry completeness-check requirements:

1. Company Letterhead: Present.
2. Applicant Name: Present.
3. Company Contact Information (address, telephone, email): Present.
4. Signatory (name, title, signature of supervisor or personnel officer): DEFECTIVE / MISSING. The document lacks the name, title, and signature of an immediate supervisor or personnel officer, containing only a generic team closing.
5. Positions Held: Present.
6. Employment Details (job title, duties, job status, dates worked, work hours per week, annual salary plus benefits): Present.

Conclusion: The document is defective and fails Express Entry completeness requirements due to the missing supervisor or personnel officer signatory block.
